## Outcome

What should the user or builder be able to do?

## Scope

Affected folder, component, or interface. Link designs and decisions.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Observable result and how to verify it

## Evidence and constraints

Identify documentation, simulation, live AI, or physical testing. Record dependencies and unresolved inputs. Paid AI is disabled by default.
